# Teaching plugin

Teaching workflows: skill mapping, practice plans, and feedback loops.

## Installation

```bash
/add-plugin teaching
```

## Components

### Skills

| Skill | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `create-learning-path` | Build a personalized learning roadmap with milestones and practice checkpoints |
| `run-learning-retrospective` | Evaluate progress, identify blockers, and adjust the learning plan |

## Source

This plugin is published by Cursor in [cursor/plugins](https://github.com/cursor/plugins) under the MIT license. Syncfusion distributes it unchanged in BoldCreate Plugins, copied at commit `4dd1d05`. The original copyright notice is kept in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Teaching**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Teaching**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install teaching@boldcreate-plugins`.
